idx_items_live_name_conversation.name: idx_items_live_name_conversation
idx_items_live_name_conversation.where: "app_artifacts"."items"."home_kind" = 'conversation' AND "app_artifacts"."items"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "app_artifacts"."items"."revoked_at" IS NULL

idx_items_live_name_server_home.name: idx_items_live_name_server_home
idx_items_live_name_server_home.where: "app_artifacts"."items"."home_kind" <> 'conversation' AND "app_artifacts"."items"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "app_artifacts"."items"."revoked_at" IS NULL

items_origin_message_via.name: items_origin_message_via
items_origin_message_via.value: "app_artifacts"."items"."origin_message_id" IS NULL OR "app_artifacts"."items"."origin_via" IS NOT NULL

version_checks_skip_reason.name: version_checks_skip_reason
version_checks_skip_reason.value: ("app_artifacts"."version_checks"."status" = 'skipped') = ("app_artifacts"."version_checks"."skip_reason" IS NOT NULL) AND ("app_artifacts"."version_checks"."skip_reason" IS NULL OR "app_artifacts"."version_checks"."skip_reason" IN ('unchanged', 'server_daily_cap', 'platform_daily_cap'))

versions_revoked_by.name: versions_revoked_by
versions_revoked_by.value: ("app_artifacts"."versions"."revoked_by_type" IS NULL) = ("app_artifacts"."versions"."revoked_by_id" IS NULL) AND ("app_artifacts"."versions"."revoked_by_type" IS NULL OR "app_artifacts"."versions"."revoked_by_type" IN ('user', 'agent'))

versions_excerpt_blocks_shape.name: versions_excerpt_blocks_shape
versions_excerpt_blocks_shape.value: "app_artifacts"."versions"."excerpt_blocks" IS NULL OR ("app_artifacts"."versions"."excerpt" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof("app_artifacts"."versions"."excerpt_blocks") = 'array' AND octet_length("app_artifacts"."versions"."excerpt_blocks"::text) <= 12288)
